(WebSearch snippets of NPR / CNBC / Times of Israel, Aug 7 2026.)

US Senate passes sweeping Russia sanctions bill; House next.

- The US Senate voted 86-11 to pass the "Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026" (Friday Aug 7).
- The bill sanctions Russian officials and authorises stiff tariffs on China, India and other countries to reduce their dependence on Russian oil and gas; it also includes expanded sanctions on Iran sought by President Trump.
- Named for Sen. Lindsey Graham (R-SC), a leading Kyiv ally in Congress, who died last month.
- Next step / caveat (advances this morning's brief): the bill goes to the House, which is on recess until September. Broad Senate support may not guarantee House passage - some lawmakers and industries are wary that new tariff powers for Trump could raise costs for US importers and consumers.
